semantics.state: Three one-bit D flip-flop outputs named xor_r, and_r, or_r
semantics.initialization: All three state bits are initialized to zero before the first clock edge; z initially equals one
semantics.clock: Positive edge of clk; all state updates use the old state and the x sampled at that edge
semantics.output: z = NOT (xor_r OR and_r OR or_r), combinational from current state
semantics.between_edges: State holds; changing x alone cannot change z
semantics.reset: No runtime reset behavior or reset input is specified

numeric.representation: All ports and state bits are single-bit unsigned logic
numeric.operations: One-bit Boolean XOR, AND, OR, complement and three-input NOR
numeric.arithmetic: No numeric addition, overflow, rounding, saturation or widening is involved

verification.oracle: Independent enumerated transition table for all eight state combinations and both binary x values, output one only in state 000
verification.startup: Check z is one before the first positive clock edge
verification.coverage: Apply every binary input sequence of length eight to a separately initialized DUT instance; check output after each positive edge
verification.timing: Change x while clk is low and verify output holds; check output after falling edges as well
verification.tools: Icarus v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top, matching vvp; finite shell and testbench timeouts
verification.scope: Independent development simulation only; no official reference or evaluation access, synthesis or board work
